items.title: BlackRock's crypto ETF assets surge 63% but remain far below 2025 peak
items.summary: The asset manager's crypto assets surged 63% to $79.6 billion as investors returned, but holdings remain 23% below year-ago levels.

items.title: Standard Chartered expands Bitcoin and Ether trading to professional investors in UAE
items.summary: Standard Chartered expanded its spot crypto trading services to professional investors in the UAE region, with plans to offer access to more market participants.
